rules: A grammar item is counted only when it changes recoverable meaning or permits understanding it, not because a sentence contains that structure.
Some early examples necessarily vary more than one feature: confounds and vocabulary support must be checked before claiming a controlled experimental contrast.
27 grammar items linked to semantic productive M; seven are R-form or R-sense. P morphological exactness is not required unless independently specified.
These are replaceable language-test examples, not lessons, scenes, characters, or approved game dialogue.
